title: A CSV importer with good errors
description:
Import a CSV of products and report every problem with its line and column.

```
products.csv: 120 rows
line 14: price "12,50" is not a number (use a dot)
line 37: missing column "stock"
line 90: stock -3 is negative
117 rows imported, 3 refused
```
hints: Return `Result<Product, RowError>` from `parse_row`, and wrap it with the line number in the loop (lesson 8.01).
`let price: f64 = text.parse()?;` works once `RowError` has `From<ParseFloatError>`.
requirements: An error enum per kind of problem, with `Display`, `Error` and `source()` where there is an underlying error.
`?` with `From` conversions inside a `parse_row` helper; collect errors instead of stopping at the first.
stretch: Use the `csv` and `serde` crates in a Cargo project and compare the code.
